angles: Thin board: across 14 Sunday games, only a few favorites show a positive averaged edge vs the DraftKings price, and none by much. Stakes are small on purpose.

0-2 teams (desperation angle): Chargers (at BUF), Commanders (vs SEA, Jayden Daniels out), Texans and Colts (vs each other), Dolphins (vs KC), Titans (at NYG), Buccaneers (vs MIN). The card needs none of them blown out -- the Fun Parlay only needs Buffalo to win, not cover.
Puka Nacua (Rams, groin/hip) is doubtful for SNF; McVay said doubtful means more unlikely than likely. Kalshi's Rams price (54%) looks like it already reflects that; ESPN's FPI (63.7%) may not.
No Lottery Ticket: this weekend's one ticket was already used on Thursday (ATL @ GB).
Sack-leader props were not researched this run (no verified DK sack prices found) -- none on the card or leg bank.
No player props on the card: the only prop price verified was McCaffrey anytime TD (Fanatics -225), and it's overpriced vs Dimers -- see Skip these.

easy_bet.selection: Los Angeles Rams moneyline (at Denver Broncos)
easy_bet.estimated_prob_source: Averaged: ESPN FPI 63.7% + Dimers 61.3% + Kalshi 54% = 179.0 / 3 = 59.7%. Spread between sources 9.7 points (inside the 10-point limit, but close). -135 implies 57.4%, so edge is about +2.2%.
easy_bet.reason_summary: Rams ML -135 (SNF). 3 sources avg 59.7% vs 57.4% implied = small +2.2% edge. Nacua doubtful -- skip if DK is shorter than -150.
easy_bet.reason: Picked on merit: the Rams are favored by every source read -- ESPN FPI 63.7%, Dimers 61.3% (projects Rams 23-20), Kalshi 54% as of 9/26. Averaged 59.7% vs DraftKings -135 (57.4% implied) = +2.2%, a small edge, not a big one. Honest caveats: (1) Puka Nacua is doubtful (missed every practice this week) and FPI may predate that news, which is why Kalshi sits 10 points lower -- the sources are only just inside the 10-point agreement rule. (2) Denver's backfield is banged up (Dobbins and Harvey questionable) and Covers expects a low-scoring game (Under 44.5), which favors the side that runs better -- LA with Kyren Williams and Blake Corum. (3) Neither team is 0-2 (both 1-1). If the DK price has moved shorter than -150, the edge is gone -- skip it. If it's moved to -125 or so (Kalshi-like), the edge is a bit bigger.

fun_parlay.estimated_prob_source: Combined true probability 76.6% x 73.2% = 56.1%. dk_odds +74 is computed from the two DK moneylines (1.294 x 1.345 = 1.740 decimal), not a quoted DK parlay price -- confirm in the app. +74 implies 57.5%, so this parlay is about -1.3% edge: no real edge.
fun_parlay.reason_summary: Bills ML + Lions ML (~+74), both 1 PM. ~56% to hit, priced about fair (-1.3% edge) -- so it's sized down to $0.15, not the full $0.25.
fun_parlay.reason: Two big home favorites, each well above the 55% leg floor, in different games from the Easy Bet (no game-script conflict). Every source agrees closely on both, but DraftKings has priced them right -- the averaged edge is slightly negative (-1.3% on the parlay). Per the 'size down, don't chase' rule it gets $0.15 instead of the $0.25 slate.py allows; the unused $0.10 stays in the weekend's stop-loss room for Monday. Skip it entirely if you'd rather not play a no-edge ticket.
